title: How much of each prompt the server took from its cache
compared: Prompt tokens each request sent against the tokens the server had to process, in the baseline replay.
sample: The 54 requests of the baseline replay of 17 audited public jobs on an aarch64 test VM, counted once each from the server log.

rows.requests: first questions cut off by the client's timeout

verdict: The second and third questions found almost all of their prompt in the cache; over all requests 67% of the prompt tokens came from it. Reading prompts took 6409 s and generating 3680 s of the 10641 s.
note: The seconds for reading prompts include the three cut-off requests. The client's timeout is not in these logs, so its length is not given here.
